shell_commands: /usr/bin/zsh -lc "sed -n '1,260p' specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md && printf '\\n--- test files ---\\n' && rg --files -g '*test*' -g '*spec*' | head -120 && printf '\\n--- lore commands ---\\n' && sed -n '1,240p' .lore/test-commands.yml && printf '\\n--- dod exists ---\\n' && if [ -f .lore/dod.md ]; then sed -n '1,220p' .lore/dod.md; fi"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "sed -n '1,260p' src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.test.ts && printf '\\n--- implementation ---\\n' && sed -n '1,230p' src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.ts && printf '\\n--- package ---\\n' && sed -n '1,220p' package.json && printf '\\n--- config test patterns ---\\n' && sed -n '1,180p' src/config.test.ts"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "rg -n \"specs/.*#|acceptance\" src specs .lore | head -100 && sed -n '1,160p' scripts/lore-list-tests.mjs && sed -n '1,140p' scripts/lore-run-test.mjs && rg -n \"CHANGELOG|changelog\" -g 'CHANGELOG*' . | head"
/usr/bin/zsh -lc "rg -n \"specs/|spec:\" src scripts --glob '*.test.ts' | head -80 && sed -n '1,100p' CHANGELOG.md && sed -n '1,80p' tsconfig.json && sed -n '1,120p' jest.config.js"
/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'git status --short && git diff --check && git diff -- .lore/dod.md specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md src/orchestration/beforeSessionFailure.acceptance.test.ts'

/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'npx prettier --write src/orchestration/beforeSessionFailure.acceptance.test.ts specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md .lore/dod.md && git diff --check && git add .lore/dod.md src/orchestration/beforeSessionFailure.acceptance.test.ts specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md && git commit -m "test(orchestration): define beforeSession failure DoD" && git push origin HEAD'
/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'git fetch origin main && git merge origin/main && git push origin HEAD && git status --short --branch'
